rationale: The original entry thesis relied on tight range compression along the 5-minute 9-EMA ($13.60) for an upside continuation, but price has instead broken below that consolidation support ($13.58–$13.60) and the 9-EMA ($13.59), now trading at $13.56. With zero favorable excursion since entry and a weakening broader market (SPY -1.48%), the consolidation has resolved downward, making an immediate exit preferable to waiting for the full $13.51 hard stop.
